cargo_subtitle: Shareable configurations and JSON recipes in config/recipes/
cargo_about_desc: Maps are self-contained, shareable JSON files. When you apply a map to a chest (WINEPREFIX), Thatch reads the required Winetricks dependencies, compares them with the ones already injected to skip existing ones and injects sequentially only the missing dependencies, optimizing the installation and preventing corrupted or redundant files.
